claim: Qwen3-TTS has optional Gradio demos, but the speech serving endpoint does not automatically publish them.
Qwen and vLLM-Omni defaults use temperature 0.9 and top_k 50 for both Talker and Subtalker.
Very low sampling settings do not reliably eliminate short-utterance onset or perceived timbre instability.
Qwen3-TTS 1.7B CustomVoice supports instruction control while the official 0.6B CustomVoice path ignores instruct.
vLLM-Omni v0.28.0 maps OpenAI Speech instructions to Qwen instruct.
vLLM-Omni v0.28.0 propagates seed to Talker and residual MTP, but FULL CUDA Graph does not preserve reproducible per-request tts_local_seed.
Speech extra_params directly override Talker sampling while Subtalker sampling remains deploy-level in vLLM-Omni v0.28.0.
Preset speaker identity and text instruction are separate conditioning paths in Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice.
Qwen CustomVoice and vLLM Speech expose no cross-request acoustic, codec, KV, or prosody continuation state.
A paragraph-sized Qwen request may improve text-level prosodic continuity, but this is not verified for Qwen3-TTS.
VoiceDesign to reusable Base clone prompt is Qwen's documented stronger multi-line identity workflow, not a CustomVoice parameter.
Preset descriptions make Serena, Uncle_Fu, and Dylan more plausible restrained narration candidates than brighter or livelier presets, without guaranteeing listening outcomes.
FFmpeg crossfade and loudness normalization cannot reconstruct speaker identity or generated prosody.
